newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 24.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed 15.49 points lower at 6,804.79 on worries that the strong dollar would hurt U.S. exports. For the week, it lost 130.67 points.
* Indonesian police detained 48 youths on Sunday after a violent "anti-integration" protest at a hotel in the East Timor capital of Dili where a United Nations envoy was staying, police said.
* On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index dropped 7.03 points, or 1.06 percent, to 656.11 points.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,402.25/04.50 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,404.75/05.75
* Semen Gresik, Daya Guna and Dharmala Sakti on announcements of their 1996 financial results.
* Mulialand on reports the exchangable bonds issue of the firm's major shareholder PT Muliasentra Gunaswakarya was oversubscribed.
* Dhamala Intiland on reports it was likely to acquire another property firm Putra Surya Perkasa.
* Transportation firm Mitra Rajasa on market talk that business tycoon Yopie Widjaja planned to acquire the firm. Widjadja has denied the rumour.
